chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: Leaving Cab Calloway before the California trip
summary: McRae left Cab at the Chicago Theater rather than go away from his children; Welburn lists the reed section in Hollywood.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Two years after Chu Berry had died.
I left Cab -- I didn't want to -- I left Cab in Chicago. Cab was going -- It was about two summers after that. I left Cab about two years. I left Cab when he played the Chicago Theater.
I told him that I didn't want to -- he was going to California -- I say I didn't want to go to California, because it'll be too long away from my kids.
I say, "I wasn't gonna stay but a couple of years." I left Cab (inaudible). I left Cab in --
